integrity.description: The agent built the containers rather than using pre-existing ones.
integrity.visual_evidence: Terminal logs showing the 'docker compose build' or 'docker compose up' process with step-by-step image layer creation.

integrity.description: The agent opened and read the source files before writing the Dockerfiles.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the agent opening files in ~/projects/acme-inventory/ (like api/app.py or config.py) in a text editor or using 'cat'.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The system must consist of 5 services: Flask API, PostgreSQL, Redis, Celery Worker, and Nginx. There should be exactly 25 products in the database (IDs 1-25, categories: ELEC, OFFC, SUPP, TECH, ACCS). There are 3 warehouses: 'West Coast Distribution Center' (ID 1), 'East Coast Fulfillment Hub' (ID 2), and 'Central Processing Facility' (ID 3). The application is hosted at http://localhost:8080.
